caveats: The DOC 2.0 API only covers January 2017 onwards. Nothing before 2017 can come from GDELT.
"p(doom)" cannot be queried: GDELT rejects the single-letter keyword "p". "pdoom" (one token) works but is rare in news text; "probability of doom" is a proxy phrase.

count is the number of monitored online news articles per month matching the query; perMillion is count per million articles GDELT monitored that month (the API norm). GDELT monitors mostly English and machine-translated news, not blogs or social media.

Rate limit is one request per 5 s and the server answers 429 for a while after any burst; the script spaces requests 15 s apart and backs off 20/40/60 s on 429. The TLS handshake alone can take over 10 s, so requests go through node:https rather than fetch.
A query marked fromCache reused the last raw response saved in raw/ because the live request was throttled; its end date is that of the saved response.
